lastResponse.text: You’re doing the right thing. Call nine one one right now and say: “Possible overdose. Hard to wake up. Breathing has long gaps. Cold and sweaty. In Gresham.” Then put him on his side, keep his airway clear, and stay with him. If he stops breathing, tell nine one one immediately and start CPR if you can. Say “calling now” so I know you’re doing it.
originalTexts: You’re doing the right thing. Call **911 right now** and say: “Possible overdose. Hard to wake up. Breathing has long gaps. Cold and sweaty. In Gresham.” Then put him on his side, keep his airway clear, and stay with him. If he stops breathing, tell 911 immediately and start CPR if you can. Say “calling now” so I know you’re doing it.
